_meta.what: Authored gacha content for the synthetic server: banners, their pools, costs, and each unit's rate WITHIN a banner.
_meta.label: AUTHORED -- NOT RECOVERED. The gacha content was transmitted, never shipped, so no banner/pool/rate here is retail data. Per-row `source` may name a [Community] provenance; that is a source label, NOT verification (docs/analysis/COMMUNITY_RESEARCH.md S1.2 -- a community artefact built from the same datamine lineage cannot verify it).
_meta.status: 2026-09-21 -- FOCUSED SET (7 banners, one per class/tab). Banner IDENTITY (id, title, description) is SHIPPED data (F_TEXT_GACHA); banner ART is a real shipped file whose featured-unit match is authored (the art<->id mapping was never shipped). POOLS are tier-based: the server expands a tier into the shipped F_UNIT_MST base-rarity units, so the unit catalogue is DERIVED, not stored. RATES are [Community] (docs/notes/gacha_community_rates.md) or authored; the tier split is labelled per banner.
_meta.decision: docs/notes/shop_gacha_scope.md S4 (one authored file, not responses.json)
_meta.unit_ids: Every unit id is a SHIPPED F_UNIT_MST master id (token 3HriTp6B). Validated at read time -- an id absent from F_UNIT_MST is an error, not a new unit.
_meta.derived_not_stored: Unit NAMES and base rarity come from F_UNIT_MST and are NOT duplicated here (one fact, one home). A `tiers` pool is expanded at read time from the base-rarity roots (F_UNIT_MST rows where 3HriTp6B == woghJa61). Tier odds are the tier rates; the per-unit rate is derived.
provenance_values: authored   -- our own number; the default
community  -- transcribed from a named [Community] source (cite it in `notes`); NOT verification
disclosed  -- from a publisher/operator rate disclosure (cite it in `notes`)
footage    -- read off archive footage of the banner screen
mixed      -- more than one of the above; per-row `source` overrides
_meta.pool_encoding_note: `rate` is a probability (0..1). The wire field GachaPanelGroupMst.targetInfo carries an INTEGER rate slot; the server converts. Whether that integer is a weight, per-mille or per-10000 is NOT yet recovered -- see gacha_reconstruction.md S6.
_meta.history: 2026-09-20 -- created (schema + illustrative banner). 2026-09-20 -- rewritten to the recovered wire chain; first real banner: the friend-point Standard Summon. 2026-09-21 -- expanded to the focused 7-banner set: tier-based pools, multi-draw (`draws`), a `guarantee`, a ticket-only banner (`ticket_group_id`), and a step-up (`steps`). The banner `type` now carries the tab code (see `capture_server.GACHA_TYPE_CODE`): free 0 / limited 50 / step 5 / normal 1.

_schema.banners[]: One entry per banner (one `GachaMst` row plus its detail/schedule/panel/panel-group rows; a step-up emits one detail row per step).
_schema.banners[].id: string, required -> GachaMst.X1IuZnj2 (gachaId) and GachaDetailMst.X1IuZnj2 / GachaScheduleMst.X1IuZnj2.
_schema.banners[].type: string, required. Semantic gacha type -> GachaMst.sx4kyW0i. TABS (recovered 2026-09-21, gacha_banner_types.md S1): 'free'/'friend' -> 0 (FREE tab); 'limited' -> 50, 'box' -> 7 (LIMITED tab); 'exchange' -> 8 (EXCHANGE tab); 'step' -> 5 and 'normal' -> 1 (PAY tab). Codes live in the server.
_schema.banners[].name: string, required -> GachaDetailMst.G4L0YIB2. **NOT the displayed title.** The client renders the title/description from the LOCALIZED TEXT TABLE keyed by gacha id (`MST_GACHA_NAME_<id>` / `MST_GACHA_EXPLAIN_*_<id>`). This field is stored but never shown; the DISPLAYED title is the SHIPPED row for `id`.
_schema.banners[].detail_id: string, required -> GachaDetailMst.nqzG3b2v. For a step-up, `steps[]` overrides this with one detail row per step.
_schema.banners[].cost: object, optional. {kind, amount, item_id?}. kind is semantic: 'friend_point'|'lapis'|'ticket'|'free'. Renders GachaDetailMst.costInfo as `kind:itemId:useCost:exeCount` (gacha_banner_types.md S4). Omitted/`free` => empty costInfo => FREE via getUseCostValue's default of 1.
_schema.banners[].ticket_group_id: int, optional. Sets GachaDetailMst.ticketGroupId (RZ6z12Dt, +0x88). With an EMPTY cost this is what makes isTicketOnlyGacha true -> TicketOnlyGachaDetailScene (gacha_banner_types.md S6a). The group must exist in the SHIPPED F_TICKET_MST (10010/10020/10040/100101).
_schema.banners[].draws: int, optional, default 1. Units drawn PER execution -> GachaDetailMst.costInfo exeCount. A 10+1 is draws=11 at one cost (NOT cost x11).
_schema.banners[].guarantee: object, optional. {rarity: int} ensures at least one draw of that tier; {unit_id: str} ensures that specific unit. Server-side only.
_schema.banners[].gacha_layout: int, optional -> GachaMst.7xBNR2MH (+0x9c). 1 = isPayGacha -> GachaPayDetailScene; 2 = isNewStepUpGacha (with type 5) -> base GachaDetailScene step-up layout. Omit for the base scene.
_schema.banners[].schedule: object, required -> GachaScheduleMst. {disp_order, banner_type, window:{from,to}}. Dates are strings; the client converts them (gacha_reconstruction.md S3.3).
_schema.banners[].region: string, required. 'jp' | 'en' | 'dual' -- which ART locales exist. Determined by whether the art basenames are present under cpk_extract/en/ ('en'), cpk_extract/common_lang/ ('jp'), or both ('dual'). The TITLE/DESCRIPTION is always the shipped English `F_TEXT_GACHA` row regardless of region; region is about the artwork (JP text is baked into the common_lang art). All seven FOCUSED-SET banners are 'jp': the standard/rare-summon `gacha_*_top` list art ships only under common_lang, while the EN `gacha_*_top` set is the 2021-2024 exchange/crown family and the EN `generalpu_bn_gacha1_*` are 500x450 home banners.
_schema.banners[].art: object, optional. {img_btn, banner, detail_banner, banner_en?, detail_banner_en?, anime_file, anime_name}. `anime_file` is the SSBP base (no extension); `anime_name` is the AnimeCache KEY `"<ssbpPack>/anime"` (e.g. `gacha_moogle_normal/anime`), NOT the SSBP file and NOT a bare pack (Player::play does a raw map find; a bare pack is a silent miss -- see capture_server.py and docs/notes/gacha_moogle_draw.md Q5b). `banner` is the LIST/wide art -> GachaScheduleMst.4yT7FUqj BARE (+0x60, fetched from the `main` dir; a 1-field entry). `detail_banner` is the DETAIL art -> the schedule's `index:file` vector (+0x78, fetched from the `sub` dir; a 2-field `0:file` entry) and the detail MST's own 4yT7FUqj. `*_en` variants are the English-locale override the server PREFERS when `GACHA_LANG=en` (default) and the file is present. Sized for their slots: the list slot is WIDE (640x160/170, a `gacha_*_top.png`), the detail slot is 640x392 (a `gacha_*.png`). The art<->banner-id match is AUTHORED. `img_btn` is a BARE base with NO extension: the BASE scene appends `_1.png`/`_2.png` (so `gacha_btn_n`), while the TICKET-ONLY scene appends `_ticket_1.png`/`_ticket_2.png` (`TicketOnlyGachaDetailScene::setBtnLayout` `0x216ae08`), so its base is a generic ticket button -- `gacha_btn_ex` for EX summon tickets (group 10010), `gacha_btn_nvex` for NV EX tickets, etc.
_schema.banners[].pool: required. EITHER an array of explicit {unit_id, rarity, rate} rows, OR an object {tiers:[{rarity, rate, featured?:[ids], featured_share?:0..1, units?:[ids]}]}. A tier WITHOUT `units` expands to every F_UNIT_MST base-rarity root of that rarity; `featured` units take `featured_share` of the tier split equally, the rest share the remainder. SUM(tier rate) should be 1.0.
_schema.banners[].steps: array, required for a step-up. One entry per step: {cost, draws, guarantee?}. Emits one GachaDetailMst row per step (exeType 1) and advances UserGachaStepInfo (7k0FbQ8B) server-side.
_schema.INVARIANT (to enforce when validation la: for an explicit pool, SUM(rate) == 1.0; for tiers, SUM(tier.rate) == 1.0 and 0 <= featured_share <= 1.

_wire.role: So this file is not designed blind. Full maps + evidence: docs/notes/gacha_reconstruction.md and docs/notes/gacha_banner_types.md. All SEMANTIC here; codes live in the server.
_wire.response_classes: GachaMstResponse (PcUrGH13) | GachaDetailMstResponse (IC0ueV5s) | GachaScheduleMstResponse (4D5k8dpI) | GachaPanelMstResponse (IF4BRuh5) | GachaPanelGroupMstResponse (MjBKwG37) | UserGachaInfoResponse (80nGg32w) | UserGachaStepInfoResponse (7k0FbQ8B).
_wire.delivery: REPLY groups, not CDN MST (verified 2026-09-20). The server chooses which reply carries them; the client is tag-agnostic.
_wire.roll_reply: GachaExeResponse (5yLD4dYI) -- one node = one UserGachaResult; the award is UJz5QED2 = 'type:id' with type 10 = unit (shop_gacha_scope.md S6).

tutorial_award.note: The forced OPENING summon's award. The tutorial request is a bare shell (no banner), so the client cannot be choosing it -- this is AUTHORED (shop_gacha_scope.md S4/S6). unitId is a real shipped F_UNIT_MST id (token 3HriTp6B) so the unit renders; it is the first row of the shipped F_GACHA_SELECT_UNIT_MST and its base rarity is 5 (rainbow). granted_rarity drives the effect pattern via F_GACHA_EFFECT_PATTERN_MST.9fW0TePj -- the LOWEST-numbered row of that rarity is chosen (id 9 for rarity 5), and the client does not validate it.

banners.name: Standard Summon
banners.notes: The friend-point 'Standard Summon' (the common pull). **THE ID IS REAL** (was the invented `990001`): the shipped English `F_TEXT_GACHA` (`Ver267_ZJz5QwAy.dat`) carries `MST_GACHA_NAME_1 = 'Standard Summon'` and `MST_GACHA_EXPLAIN_LONG_1` with the `<param=friendpoint>` fill-in, so the client renders the real title AND description from shipped data. `GachaDetailMst.isFriendGacha` (0x1cecb24) is true iff a cost entry's kind == 51, so cost.kind='friend_point' is what makes the client accept it as a friend summon. POOL 2026-09-21: now TIER-BASED (1/2/3 star) over the shipped catalogue; the previous hand-written 16-row pool was a placeholder. RATES authored, tier split 50/45/5. ART is a 640x392 STAND-IN (`gacha_20200430_free_daily_10ren.png`) -- the authentic common-pool banner art was CDN-supplied and is in NO shipped CPK. `img_btn` = the summon-button BASE name (bare, no extension); the client appends `_1.png`/`_2.png`.

banners.name: Featured Summon
banners.notes: The standard PAY-tab 'Featured Summon' -- the family the archive's rare-summon banner belongs to (the VIDEO's detail screen is titled 'Featured Summon'). MULTI-BUTTON (authored 2026-09-22): the trio Summon 500 / 11 Summons 5000 / Ticket Summon. `ticket_group_id` 10010 adds the ticket button (its art is the PRIMARY row's base + '_ticket': `gacha_btns_gold_1_ticket_1.png`); `secondary_offer` emits the second `GachaDetailMst` row (`ijEey5f7=2`), the only lever on the button count. `img_btn_primary`/`img_btn` are the retail gold template -- the ornate `gacha_btn_r` is the BASE template's art and overlaps these 204x96 anchors. See docs/notes/gacha_multi_button.md §14.

banners.name: Rare Summon
banners.notes: The PAY-tab Rare Summon. **ID + COST + FEATURED UNITS ARE FROM THE SHIPPED TEXT**: `MST_GACHA_EXPLAIN_LONG_9` = 'Huge drop rate boosts for Warrior of Light, Lenna & Tellah! ... Summon once for 500 lapis, or 1 summon ticket.' Featured ids: Warrior of Light `201000104` (base 4), Lenna (FFV) `205000203` (base 3), Tellah `204000503` (base 3) -- all shipped F_UNIT_MST rows. RATES: `[Community]` 2018-era model (docs/notes/gacha_community_rates.md S1a) -- rainbow 1% / gold 19% / blue 80%; the featured units take 50% of their tier (4-star WOL) and 30% of the 3-star tier (Lenna/Tellah). The 5-star tier has no authored feature. ART: a shipped `generalpu_bn_gacha1_*` file; the art<->id match is AUTHORED (the real mapping was transmitted). MULTI-BUTTON (authored 2026-09-22): `ticket_group_id` 10010 is required by this banner's OWN shipped text ("Summon once for 500 lapis, or 1 summon ticket") -- it adds the ticket button. `secondary_offer` (lapis 5000 / 11 draws) emits a SECOND `GachaDetailMst` row with `exeType=2`, which is the ONLY lever on the summon-button count, giving the archive's three-button layout; the 11-pull is NOT in the shipped text (no shipped banner describes a single AND a multi together -- measured), so it is a layout probe. `GACHA_MULTI_BTN=0` suppresses it for an A/B. Mechanism: `docs/notes/gacha_multi_button.md`.

banners.name: Premium 10+1 Summon
banners.notes: PAY-tab 10+1. `MST_GACHA_EXPLAIN_LONG_24` = 'Summon only 4★ and 5★ units!' -- so the pool EXCLUDES the 3-star tier. Cost 5000 lapis for `draws=11` (one execution; the cost grammar's `exeCount` field carries the 11). RATES: `[Community]` -- the standard 1%/19% renormalised over the 4-star+only pool => 5%/95%. No feature. ART authored->file.

banners.name: 5★ Guaranteed 10+1 Summon
banners.notes: PAY-tab guaranteed banner. `MST_GACHA_EXPLAIN_LONG_33` = 'Get a guaranteed 5★ unit!'. `guarantee.rarity = 5` means the server forces at least one 5-star draw among the 11 (the guarantee is server-side; the client does not model it). RATES: standard `[Community]` 1%/19%/80%. ART authored->file.
